# Test fonts

`Ahem.ttf` (Ahem version 1.50) is copied unmodified from
[web-platform-tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fonts/Ahem.ttf).
The Ahem font belongs to the public domain; in jurisdictions that do not
recognize public domain ownership, the Creative Commons Zero declaration
embedded in the font applies.

Nearly every glyph is a 1em × 1em square with a 1em advance, so text metrics
are exact and identical on every platform, regardless of system fonts.
